lines.text: MangoLeaf A-I checks mango health right on your phone, even offline.
Tap Take Photo to capture one clear mango leaf or fruit.
Center one whole mango in the guide, then capture your photo.
Review your photo, then run the A-I diagnosis.
Your photo is checked on-device. Please wait a moment.
See the predicted condition, confidence, and care guidance.
Switch to Bisaya to share these treatment steps.
Saved scans stay in History for a quick return.
Open a saved scan to review the photo and result.
Switch guidance to Bisaya when it helps.
Clear Bisaya guidance helps growers choose next steps.
